resources.string: Run this on your PC, then paste the link it prints. Links work once and expire after a few minutes.
Point the camera at the QR code the PC terminal shows.
Camera denied. Paste the link instead.
That is not a pairing link. Paste the full link the PC printed.

1. On the PC, run `vfox-plus serve --port 8080` (or the Docker image) and keep it running.

2. The terminal prints a pairing link, a QR code and, for HTTPS, a certificate fingerprint.

3. Scan the QR code, or paste the link here and connect. If the server uses a self-signed certificate, compare its fingerprint with the PC terminal before trusting it.

4. The app stays paired and reconnects on the same network. The phone must reach the PC (same Wi-Fi or another route) and the port must be allowed through the PC firewall.
The server uses a self-signed certificate. Only continue if this fingerprint matches the one on the PC terminal:\n\n%1$s
The server certificate cannot be verified. Only continue on a network you trust.
Cannot reach the server. Check the network and try again.
